note: BH-7971 (BH-7940.3): seconds the prompts step of bin/fleet-propagate.sh gives bin/prompt-render.sh on each tick (`timeout $PROMPT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_S`). Read as ${PROMPT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_S:-120}; 0 or a non-numeric value logs one line and uses 120. A timeout logs one line and the tick pushes the files the render left; the next run removes its *.tmp files.
